Signature
One handwritten line in the margin of a bookish page: a soft round serif title, book text, and a single note in a hand face set straight, as if added at the counter that morning.
Use when
Bakeries, cafés, small producers, farm shops, craft workshops, recipe newsletters.
Turns into slop when
When the note is tilted, taped or stuck on as a sticker, when there are hand notes everywhere, or when kraft-paper and string props are drawn in.
